additional_info.subject: Case Update
additional_info.body:
During our inspection, we observed that
IMD BC2 was measuring 112 kΩ
, which indicated a potential insulation issue. Upon further investigation, we discovered an
aluminum foil strip stuck between the negative busbar and the body of the charger
(see attached picture).
After removing the foil,
IMD BC2 measured 20 MΩ
, confirming that the insulation issue was resolved.
